# func to organize outputs

```{r outputs}

print_anova_results <- function(anova_table) {

  df <- as.data.frame(anova_table)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {

    effect <- rownames(df)[i]

    # Clean variable names
    effect <- gsub("_reversed", "", effect)
    effect <- gsub("_base", " (baseline)", effect)

    df1 <- df$NumDF[i]
    df2 <- df$DenDF[i]
    F_value <- df[["F value"]][i]
    p <- df[["Pr(>F)"]][i]

    # Significance symbols
    stars <- if (p < .001) "***" else if (p < .01) "**" else if (p < .05) "*" else if (p < .10) "†" else ""

    # Format p-value
    p_text <- if (p < .001) "< .001" else sprintf("= %.3f", p)

    cat(sprintf(
      "%s: F(%.0f, %.2f) = %.2f, p %s%s\n",
      effect, df1, df2, F_value, p_text, stars
    ))
  }
}

print_trend_results <- function(trends_df) {

  # Identify slope estimate column
  trend_col <- grep("\\.trend$", names(trends_df), value = TRUE)

  # Calculate signed r-equivalent effect size
  trends_df$r_equiv <- with(trends_df, t.ratio / sqrt(t.ratio^2 + df))

  for (i in 1:nrow(trends_df)) {

    drug_name <- ifelse(trends_df$Drug[i] == 1, "Oxytocin", "Placebo")

    myp <- trends_df$p.value[i]

    # Significance symbols
    stars <- if (myp < .001) "***" else if (myp < .01) "**" else if (myp < .05) "*" else if (myp < .10) "†" else ""

    # Format p-value
    p_text <- if (myp < .001) "< .001" else sprintf("= %.3f", myp)

    cat(sprintf(
      "%s: β = %.4f, SE = %.4f, 95%% CI [%.4f, %.4f], t(%.2f) = %.3f, r_equiv = %.4f, p %s%s\n",
      drug_name,
      trends_df[[trend_col]][i],
      trends_df$SE[i],
      trends_df$lower.CL[i],
      trends_df$upper.CL[i],
      trends_df$df[i],
      trends_df$t.ratio[i],
      trends_df$r_equiv[i],
      p_text, stars
    ))
  }
}

print_trend_results_tp <- function(trends_df) {

  # Split by timepoint
  tp_groups <- split(trends_df, trends_df$TP)

  for (tp in names(tp_groups)) {
    cat("\nTP =", tp, ":\n")

    mydf <- tp_groups[[tp]]
    mydf$r_equiv <- with(mydf, t.ratio / sqrt(t.ratio^2 + df))

    trend_col <- grep("\\.trend$", names(mydf), value = TRUE)

    for (i in 1:nrow(mydf)) {
      drug_name <- ifelse(mydf$Drug[i] == 1, "Oxytocin", "Placebo")

      myp <- mydf$p.value[i]

      # Significance symbols
      stars <- if (myp < .001) "***" else if (myp < .01) "**" else if (myp < .05) "*" else if (myp < .10) "†" else ""

      # Format p-value
      p_text <- if (myp < .001) "< .001" else sprintf("= %.3f", myp)

      cat(sprintf(
        "%s: β = %.4f, SE = %.4f, 95%% CI [%.4f, %.4f], t(%.2f) = %.3f, r_equiv = %.4f, p %s%s\n",
        drug_name,
        mydf[[trend_col]][i],
        mydf$SE[i],
        mydf$lower.CL[i],
        mydf$upper.CL[i],
        mydf$df[i],
        mydf$t.ratio[i],
        mydf$r_equiv[i],
        p_text, stars
      ))
    }
  }
}
```

```{r breakdown,echo=FALSE, eval = FALSE}

# LMM
# --> step 1: lmm

modelex = lmer(Alpha ~ Alpha_base + TP*Drug*Alertness_base_reversed + (1|id), data=data_eo)
anovaex = anova(modelex, type=3)
cat("\nANOVA MAIN MODEL\n")
print(anovaex)
#print_anova_results(anovaex)

# found 3-way Time × Drug × Alertness

# BREAKDOWN
# ----- THREE-WAY INTERACTION FOLLOW-UP -----

# 1. Estimate all 12 slopes
# Does the alertness–alphs association differ between drugs at each timepoint?

trendstp <- emtrends(modelex, ~ Drug | TP,var = "Alertness_base_reversed")

# 2. Compare drug slopes at each timepoint
drug_differences <- pairs(trendstp)
drug_diff_df <- as.data.frame(summary(drug_differences, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), adjust = "none"))
cat("\nDRUG DIFFERENCES IN SLOPES AT EACH TP -- UNCORRECTED\n")
drug_diff_df

# Correct across six comparisons
drug_diff_df$p_holm <- p.adjust(drug_diff_df$p.value,method = "holm")
cat("\nDRUG DIFFERENCES IN SLOPES AT EACH TP - CORRECTED (JUST IN CASE; I DONT THINK WE WANT THIS ONE\n")
print(drug_diff_df)

# 3. Test whether slopes vary over time within each drug
# Does the alertness–alpha association change across timepoints within each drug?

trends_by_drug <- emtrends(modelex,~ TP | Drug,var = "Alertness_base_reversed")
pairs(trends_by_drug, adjust = "none")


# Omnibus test of timepoint differences in slopes,separately for each drug
test(contrast(trends_by_drug, "eff"),joint = TRUE,by = "Drug")
time_effects <- test(contrast(trends_by_drug, "eff"),joint = TRUE,by = "Drug")

cat("\nDO ALERTNESS SLOPES VARY ACROSS TP WITHIN DRUG?\n")
print(time_effects)

# 4. Test individual slopes against zero
# Which individual slopes differ from zero?
individual_slopes <- as.data.frame(summary(trendstp, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))
cat("\nINDIVIDUAL SLOPES\n")
print(individual_slopes)


# 5. Test overall slopes against zero -- as we did before, we probably dont need this here
trendsfull <- emtrends(modelex,~ Drug,var = "Alertness_base_reversed")
trendsfull_df <- as.data.frame(summary(trendsfull, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))
cat("\nOVERALL SLOPES MAIN MODEL\n")
print(trendsfull_df)
```

```{r csv, echo=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)

# ----- FORMATTING -----

format_p <- function(p) {

  if (is.na(p)) return("N/A")

  stars <- if (p < .001) "***"
  else if (p < .01) "**"
  else if (p < .05) "*"
  else if (p < .10) "t"
  else ""

  p_text <- if (p < .001) "< .001"
  else sprintf("= %.3f", p)

  paste0("p ", p_text, stars)
}


# ----- OMNIBUS EFFECTS -----

get_anova_results <- function(anova_table, behav_var) {

  df <- as.data.frame(anova_table)
  effects <- rownames(df)

  # Only significant/trending effects involving mental state
  keep <- grepl(behav_var, effects, fixed = TRUE) &
    !is.na(df[["Pr(>F)"]]) &
    df[["Pr(>F)"]] < .10

  df <- df[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  effects <- effects[keep]

  if (nrow(df) == 0) return("n.s.")

  results <- character(nrow(df))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {

    effect <- effects[i]

    effect <- gsub("_base_reversed", "", effect, fixed = TRUE)
    effect <- gsub("_base", "", effect, fixed = TRUE)
    effect <- gsub(":", " x ", effect, fixed = TRUE)

    df1 <- df$NumDF[i]
    df2 <- df$DenDF[i]
    F_value <- df[["F value"]][i]
    p <- df[["Pr(>F)"]][i]

    # Unsigned partial-r magnitude
    r <- sqrt((F_value * df1) / (F_value * df1 + df2))

    results[i] <- sprintf(
      "%s: F(%.0f, %.2f) = %.2f, r = %.2f, %s",
      effect, df1, df2, F_value, r, format_p(p)
    )
  }

  paste(results, collapse = "\n")
}


# ----- OVERALL SLOPES -----

get_slope_results <- function(trends_df) {

  trend_col <- grep("\\.trend$", names(trends_df), value = TRUE)

  results <- character(nrow(trends_df))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(trends_df))) {

    drug_name <- if (as.character(trends_df$Drug[i]) == "1") {
      "OT"
    } else if (as.character(trends_df$Drug[i]) == "2") {
      "PL"
    } else {
      as.character(trends_df$Drug[i])
    }

    results[i] <- sprintf(
      "%s: beta = %.4f, t(%.2f) = %.2f, %s",
      drug_name,
      trends_df[[trend_col]][i],
      trends_df$df[i],
      trends_df$t.ratio[i],
      format_p(trends_df$p.value[i])
    )
  }

  paste(results, collapse = "\n")
}


# ----- TIMEPOINT-SPECIFIC SLOPES -----



get_tp_results <- function(trends_tp_df, trends_full_df) {

  # Only drugs with significant/trending overall slopes
  qualifying_drugs <- as.character(
    trends_full_df$Drug[
      !is.na(trends_full_df$p.value) &
      trends_full_df$p.value < .10
    ]
  )

  if (length(qualifying_drugs) == 0) return("N/A")

  trend_col <- grep("\\.trend$", names(trends_tp_df), value = TRUE)
  full_trend_col <- grep("\\.trend$", names(trends_full_df), value = TRUE)

  results <- character()

  for (drug in qualifying_drugs) {

    drug_name <- if (drug == "1") "OT"
    else if (drug == "2") "PL"
    else drug

    drug_df <- trends_tp_df[
      as.character(trends_tp_df$Drug) == drug,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    drug_df <- drug_df[
      order(as.numeric(as.character(drug_df$TP))),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    # Overall slope direction
    overall_row <- trends_full_df[
      as.character(trends_full_df$Drug) == drug,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    direction <- if (
      overall_row[[full_trend_col]][1] > 0
    ) "+" else "-"

    # Format all six timepoint slopes
    tp_text <- character(nrow(drug_df))

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(drug_df))) {

      # Signed r-equivalent effect size
      t_value <- drug_df$t.ratio[i]
      df_value <- drug_df$df[i]

      r <- t_value / sqrt(t_value^2 + df_value)

      tp_text[i] <- sprintf(
        "TP%s: beta = %.4f, t(%.2f) = %.2f, r = %.2f, %s",
        as.character(drug_df$TP[i]),
        drug_df[[trend_col]][i],
        df_value,
        t_value,
        r,
        format_p(drug_df$p.value[i])
      )
    }

    results <- c(
      results,
      paste0(
        drug_name, " (", direction, "):\n",
        paste(tp_text, collapse = ";\n")
      )
    )
  }

  paste(results, collapse = "\n")
}




# ----- MAIN ANALYSIS -----

results_list <- list()
result_index <- 1

for (eyes_cond in c("eyes_open", "eyes_closed")) {

  if (eyes_cond == "eyes_open") {
    mydata_main <- data_eo
    printeyes <- "Eyes open"
  } else {
    mydata_main <- data_ec
    printeyes <- "Eyes closed"
  }

  # Ensure categorical predictors
  mydata_main$TP <- factor(mydata_main$TP)
  mydata_main$Drug <- factor(mydata_main$Drug)

  behav_vars <- c(
    "Alertness_base_reversed",
    "Excitement_base_reversed",
    "Sociability_base_reversed"
  )

  for (behav_var in behav_vars) {

    printbehav <- gsub(
      "_base_reversed", "",
      behav_var,
      fixed = TRUE
    )

    for (band in c("Theta", "Alpha", "Beta")) {

      analysis_name <- paste(
        printeyes,
        paste("Baseline", printbehav),
        band,
        sep = " x "
      )

      cat("Running:", analysis_name, "\n")

      # ----- STEP 1: OMNIBUS LMM -----

      formula_str <- paste0(band, " ~ ",band, "_base + TP*Drug*", behav_var," + (1|id)")

      modelfull <- lmer(
        as.formula(formula_str),
        data = mydata_main,
        control = lmerControl(
          optimizer = "bobyqa",
          optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000)
        )
      )

      anovafull <- anova(modelfull, type = 3)

      omnibus_text <- get_anova_results(
        anovafull,
        behav_var
      )

      # Default values
      slopes_text <- "N/A"
      tp_text <- "N/A"

      # ----- STEP 2: OVERALL SLOPES -----

      if (omnibus_text != "n.s.") {

        trendsfull <- emtrends(
          modelfull,
          ~ Drug,
          var = behav_var
        )

        trendsfull_df <- as.data.frame(
          summary(
            trendsfull,
            infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
          )
        )

        slopes_text <- get_slope_results(
          trendsfull_df
        )

        # ----- STEP 3: TIMEPOINT SLOPES -----

        # Only run if at least one overall slope
        # is significant or trending
        if (any(
          trendsfull_df$p.value < .10,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )) {

          trendstp <- emtrends(
            modelfull,
            ~ Drug | TP,
            var = behav_var
          )

          trendstp_df <- as.data.frame(
            summary(
              trendstp,
              infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
            )
          )

          tp_text <- get_tp_results(
            trendstp_df,
            trendsfull_df
          )
        }
      }

      # ----- STORE RESULTS -----

      results_list[[result_index]] <- data.frame(
        "Analysis" = analysis_name,
        "Significant baseline-related omnibus effects" =
          omnibus_text,
        "Significant overall slopes" =
          slopes_text,
        "Timepoint-specific slopes" =
          tp_text,
        check.names = FALSE
      )

      result_index <- result_index + 1
    }
  }
}


# ----- SAVE CSV -----

results_final <- dplyr::bind_rows(results_list)

path_to_savefile3 = paste0("//Users/abhishekanand/Documents/OTPH_TF/NEW_results/result_RR_behavBASE_FINAL20261115_", whichpower, "__resultsastable.csv")


dir.create(
  dirname(path_to_savefile3),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  results_final,
  file = path_to_savefile3,
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nDONE! Formatted table results saved to:\n", path_to_savefile3, "\n")
```
